note: EXAMPLE / TEMPLATE. Copy to standards.json and adapt to your project — narrow `paths` to your source root and replace these with the baseline standards your codebase should uphold. A standard = an idea with an executable `ast` detector. See ../knowledge/detector-model.md for the detector model and how to add one.

ideas.label: External DB connections must have error handling
ideas.statement: Code that opens a connection to an external database must do so inside exception handling, so an unreachable host or bad credential surfaces as an actionable failure rather than an unhandled traceback.

solves: an external DB being down or misconfigured crashes the request with a raw traceback
contract.applies_when: code opens a connection to an external database

ideas.label: Outbound HTTP requests must set a timeout
ideas.statement: Every outbound requests.* call must pass an explicit timeout, so a hung or slow remote host cannot block a worker or request indefinitely.

solves: a hung remote host blocks a worker or request forever when no timeout is set
improves: resilience of every outbound HTTP integration
contract.applies_when: code makes an outbound HTTP call via the requests library
